My dear [Miss Smith](/person/263)
Many thanks for Delicia, who is very pretty, and I shall be very glad of her when I can put her in.[^2]
I envy the spirit of the people who finished their Whitsuntide decorations before the early service. I am thankful enough to get them all done on Saturday

yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^2]: In fact Delicia Darling: A Kentish Medley did not appear in MP until August 1886.
